Type: floral traditional runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: traditional, classic, bohemian
Materials: low pile woven fibers, distressed finish
Colors: dark blue, gold, cream, burgundy accents
Shape: long narrow runner, repeating floral kaleidoscope medallions, ornate scrolling motifs, thin blue border, low profile
Feel: rich, elegant, warm
Goes with: dark wood, brass, cream walls, jewel tones; traditional or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Floral Kaleidoscope Traditional Runner, 2'2" x 7'6", Blue Multi
product.description: With its gorgeous floral designs in striking color palettes of gold and red on a distressed blue field, this rug will impart a robust element to any setting. The powerloomed fiber blend ensures durability and beauty. 2'2" x 7'6" 75% polypropylene, 25% polyester Powerloomed construction in Turkey Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
